caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object with a stepped and curved profile, rendered in shades of yellow and beige, suggesting a wood-like texture. The front face features a circular decorative element with a radial pattern composed of alternating red and beige segments, resembling a stylized flower or star. The edges of the object's front and top sides are bordered with red and green bands. On the flat top surface, there is a recessed rectangular section with inner green borders. The object rests on a flat, unadorned surface with no discernible background details, and the artist's name, "Edward T. Jewett," is inscribed in small text on the right side of the image.
title: Candleholder (Ecclesiastical)
